{{Top|ca|leg|canon=Solloops hairstyle|notoc=1}}
[[File:Solloops-CVD.png|thumb|right|300px|Nyrat Agira wore her hair in the latest iteration of the Solloops hairstyle.]]
The '''solloops hairstyles''',<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> also known as the '''solloop style''', were curving<ref name="db">{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref> [[Hair/Legends|hairstyles]] that originated from<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Solloops [[Hair/Legends|hairstyles]]|system=[[Solloops system/Legends|Solloops system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Solloops system/Legends|Solloops system]] in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the<ref name="db" /> religious<ref name="CSWEZealots">{{CSWECite|III|369|Zealots of Psusan}}</ref> cult [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]],<ref name="db" /> wore the latest iteration<ref name="FF96" /> of the hairstyle to the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE2" /> That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she<ref name="db" /> wore the style again when visiting the club shortly after an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> The latest version<ref name="FF96" /> consisted of tall<ref name="db" /> sprayed curlicues<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> rising like [[Snake/Legends|serpents]] from the back of the wearers head.<ref name="FF96" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The guidebooks ''Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary'' and ''Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones'' spotlight Nyrat Agira in brief passages, revealing that her eye color is artificial, her hair done in the “solloop” style, and her tattoo a mark of the Zealots of Psusan cult.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ep2VDcover.jpg|thumb|right|200px|''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary'' provided a name for the solloops hairstyles.]]
The solloops hairstyles were created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="aotc" /> An iteration of the hairstyle was first revealed<ref name="On location" /> on [[September 12]], [[2000]]<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> when the<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/7.html|series=On Location|text=Part 7 - Color Me Star Wars}}</ref> uncredited<ref name="aotc" /> extra playing Nyrat Agira introduced the seventh episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location" /> The hairstyle first appeared in an illustration in the young readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> The hairstyle was identified in the [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] written reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="aotcvis" /> Both works were published on [[April 23]], 2002,<ref name="BHRelease">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref><ref name="VDRelease">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref> before the film's release on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year2">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> 

The hairstyles were identified as solloop style in Agira's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry posted on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="db" /> on [[June 14]], 2002.<ref name="Coruscant Nightlife">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/06/news20020614.html|text=Coruscant Nightlife}}</ref> The capitalization of the hairstyle was later provided in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 96|ninety-sixth issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine series, published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="FF96" /> on [[October 29]], [[2003]]<ref name="FFDate">{{FFdates|96}}</ref> and authored by [[Iain Lowson]].<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> Author [[Daniel Wallace]]'s article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]", which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> used the name "solloop" style.<ref name="Insider" />
